name: How do I choose a contractor for rotted window frame replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for rotted window frame replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for rotted window frame replacement, look for one with experience specifically in window and exterior repairs, especially in the Bay Area's unique climate. Check their licensing and insurance to ensure they are properly credentialed. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolio of similar projects. Obtain multiple detailed quotes to compare scope of work, materials, and cost. A good contractor will also clearly communicate the process, expected timeline, and offer a warranty on their work and materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience and good references. Compare multiple detailed quotes and ensure they offer clear communication and warranties.
